result.summary: Found 1 major content issue: an invalid '-100%' discount badge displayed on the bottom restaurant card.

issues.description: The promotional badge on the pizza restaurant card at the bottom of the 'Popular right now' section displays '-100%', indicating an erroneous discount calculation or invalid promotional data.
issues.suggestion: Fix the discount calculation logic and validate promotional percentage values so invalid discounts like '-100%' are not rendered, or hide the badge when valid discount data is unavailable.
